text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stop by to watch one of Mejiro Palmer's dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wahey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey! Woo!
choice_data_list: Is this… part of the lesson?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heyo! How's it going?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We're not playing hooky or anything, 'kay? We just needed to shake things up.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer was feeling down in the dumps, so I decided to cheer her up the Helios way! Can I get a "Wahey-hey"?! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's no biggie. I just can't get the choreography down right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The song we're working on is, like, super hard, and I keep messing up the steps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure I'm perf once it's go time on stage, so no worries!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I should probably get back to it, though.
choice_data_list: Don't overthink it and just dance for fun, like you just were doing.
Let's think about the meaning behind the moves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What? Are you telling me to just let loose?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Your moves looked so carefree and fluid.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's a good point! Dancing is about feeling, and what's better than feelin' great?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh. I guess I got so hung up on being perfect that it started messin' with my vibes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, then! Who cares about messing up, anyway?! I'm gonna dance 'cause I like it! Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Those moves are straight fire, girl!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I get the feeling I'm dancing way better than I did before we took a break!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Palmer is reminded of the pure fun that comes with dancing and overcomes her negative mindset.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah. All the moves have a meaning, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Maybe if I can get a better feel of what the song's about before trying to memorize the moves, things'll be easier…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Are you thinking what I'm thinking? 'Cause I'm thinking it's time for some karaoke!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh, yeah! The best way to mull over song lyrics is while you're singing them with your whole chest!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey! That's what I'm talkin' 'bout! C'mon, what're we still doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wahey! You come with us too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Mejiro Palmer deepens her understanding of the song and masters the dance in no time.
